name: paper-polish-ar
description: Polish a correct AI-generated paper draft into publishable, human-sounding prose without touching the science. Freezes data/claims/citations; rewrites wording, structure, and flow toward top-journal quality. A config-driven JS workflow spawns a goal-driven reviser + read-only reviewers that retrieve task-neutral capability skills at runtime (fidelity, logic, results, readability, ai-tells); a pre-edit hook mechanically enforces the freeze; convergence is self-judged with per-round git history.
